audit.whatIsWrong: The lane's actual difficulty lever — Frostbite doubling on a chilled target — appeared only once, buried in a Do's bullet, and the numbers were nowhere.
audit.why: Anivia kit: E 4s cooldown, 650 range, 'If the target was recently hit by Flash Frost or damaged by a fully formed Glacial Storm, the damage they take is doubled.' Q is 11/10/9/8/7 at 1075 and travels slowly.
audit.corrected: Sidestep the 1075 Flash Frost and her 4-second Frostbite never doubles; that single dodge is the whole early lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: All seven full-layer phases[].side read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Anivia/Anivia/Anivia — the page answered every row twice. whys[3] also described Glacial Storm taking over at Levels 4-5, one full stage before Anivia has her ult.
audit.why: packet.levelChart matches win[0..6]; Glacial Storm is the R and arrives at 6.
audit.corrected: Levels 1 through 4-5 Hwei, then Anivia from level 6 onward as Glacial Storm and Crystallize take the lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three interactions were absent: Frostbite's doubled damage condition, Crystallize as a 17s 1000-range wall that cuts you off from your own detonation, and Rebirth meaning she has to be killed twice. spikes[0] also called Frostbite '(Q)' — it is her E.
audit.why: Anivia kit slots and cooldowns; P text 'reverts to an egg and is reborn with full health'; W 17s flat, range 1000.
audit.corrected: Stay unchilled, detonate before the wall lands, and never commit a combo you cannot follow through the egg.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit in it (lint).
audit.why: Flash Frost 11/10/9/8/7, Frostbite 4 flat, Crystallize 17 flat, Glacial Storm 4/3/2.
audit.corrected: Field now carries Q's 11s, E's 4s and W's 17s.

audit.whatIsWrong: 23 MISGENDER hits, two COPY_PASTE_BLEED bullets, and one PLACEHOLDER PHRASING hit ('Rylai's-style items').
audit.why: champ-data/champ-gender.js marks anivia female; lintFindings names both bleed fields; the item clause names no actual item.
audit.corrected: Pronouns fixed, bleed bodies rewritten to match their titles, and the placeholder item clause replaced with the real reason she takes over.

notes: Level chart: all seven full-layer phases[].side read 'Skill' while content win[] and packet.levelChart both read Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Hwei/Anivia/Anivia/Anivia. I moved the full layer onto the content layer, which was already correct, so no paired win[N] edit was needed. I also fixed whys[3], which described Glacial Storm taking the lane over at Levels 4-5 — one stage before she has an ult — while its own row read Hwei. The suspectName flag on spikes[3] ('Glacial Storm's') is a FALSE POSITIVE; Glacial Storm is her real R. Slot error corrected: spikes[0] called Frostbite '(Q)'; it is her E. Removed a placeholder item phrase ('Rylai's-style items') and a magnitude claim with no source ('unkillable Rebirth passive' — the egg is killable, which is the actual coaching point). One thing I did NOT touch and want on the record: diff reads EVEN at 5.5/10 while the chart now hands Anivia levels 6, first item and 2+ items, and the win rate is 55.37% to Hwei over 1,817 games. Those can all be true (Hwei wins the lane, Anivia wins the game), so I left the rating alone rather than guess. phases[].rating untouched for the same reason as the other files — the scale's direction is unresolved.
